intro:
It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before!
Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!
description:
Enjoy goldfish scooping anytime on Nintendo Switch™!
Aim for a high score in solo play, or compete with up to 4 players in exciting multiplayer battles!

Grab items and gain the upper hand!
Make your poi bigger, boost your movement speed, and catch tons of fish!
Sometimes you'll even be able to hinder your rivals and turn the tide of the match!
Chaotic action and constant surprises mean it's anyone's game until the very end!

[Classic Stage]
Enjoy the festival atmosphere in this traditional goldfish scooping experience!
Catch a variety of goldfish and rack up the highest score possible!

[Japanese Stage]
A beautiful stage inspired by traditional rock gardens!
Use the flow of the water to skillfully scoop up goldfish as they drift by!

[Colorful Stage]
Dive into a colorful toy-box world packed with surprises!
Toy goldfish and unpredictable gimmicks create nonstop chaos!

Watch out for explosive pufferfish that affect everything around them!
Beware of sharks that gobble up other fish!
Take on gigantic boss fish that require multiple scoops to catch!

Face a never-ending stream of unique challenges in the ultimate goldfish scooping experience!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many goldfish as you can before time runs out!
Chain catches together and target high-value fish to set a new personal best!

[Battle]
Battle it out with up to 4 players!
Use items strategically and scoop more goldfish than your opponents to claim victory!

[Rankings]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Can you become a true goldfish scooping master?
